title: EstelloXL H Fully Automatic Top Load 9.0 kg
category: Home Appliances > Washing Machines > Top Load
key_features: 5 Star Rating : BEE (Bureau of Energy Efficiency) has rated this machine with highest “5 Star” rating. Consumes minimum energy and water with best wash performance
In Built Heater : AntiBecterial Washing with In Built heater , Get rid of harmful bacteria , germs , allergans with Anti Bacteria Wash that washes and sanitized clothes at temperature at 60 °C
Puro Drum : The outer drum has reinforced glass within the structure ensuring strength , less vibrations and durability.
8 i-Sense Technology : Activates automated features and inbuilt sensors for best performance.
Soft close glass Lids : Super silent most convenient and safe to use wash lids

Zero (Low) Pressure Technology : This technology helps you wash clothes in low water pressure. It ensures the washing continues even if your home experiences low water pressure. The inlet valves can operate at a very low water pressure.
Swift Dry : Spin Tub rotates at a high RPM, also air enters through the Spin lid perforations help to dry the cloth faster & better.
